name: CRACK_RGR
comment: RGR changed the credit line of the title screen from (c)VIRGIN GAMES 1983 to (c) MIKE GAMES 1983.

name: RUN_STATE
comment: Run state: both releases were saved from a game that had run, so these bytes hold the values that the game wrote at run time, not the values of the game file.

name: RUN_STATE_RGR
comment: Run state that only the RGR memory dump has: game charset bytes at $3150-$315f that the game wrote, and two bytes after the code that no run reads.

name: TRAINER
comment: Infinite lives of Derbyshire Ram: the answer Y to INFINITE LIVES ? writes $a5 at $417c, so the DEC of the lives counter becomes an LDA.

name: TRAINER
comment: Infinite lives of Derbyshire Ram: the answer Y to INFINITE LIVES ? writes $a5 at $417c, so the DEC of the lives counter becomes an LDA. Side effect: lives stays 3, so the first-jet test at $4163 passes at each new jet, and wait_fire_to_start clears the score (run runs/trainer_score).
